messages:
elena_sec: Heads-up — multiple eu-west proxy-sidecars started spitting TLS warnings and we're seeing KMS decrypt denies in the same time window. Not a full outage but cert fetch is falling back to cached certs.

raj_oncall: Can you paste the exact log lines? Which service account is doing the decrypt?

elena_sec: paste from logs: `ERROR cert-broker: failed to unwrap key: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied.` Service account used: `svc-cert-broker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

maria_infra: We rolled an RBAC change this morning to tighten service account scopes in eu. Might be that. I flagged the PR — pinged infra-iam.

elena_sec: @maria_infra that would line up with the timestamps (09:12 UTC). Also seeing audit events: `projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity` with KMS DENY entries. But our audit-forwarder (splunk) doesn't correlate identity -> request ID cleanly.

raj_oncall: Quick triage steps I recommend: 1) Confirm the SA still has roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the key ring/key. 2) Check IAM policy binding diffs (who removed it). 3) Retry decrypt with gcloud using the SA token to reproduce.

elena_sec: I tried reproducing locally with ADC and got same error. Command I used: 
```
ACCESS_TOKEN=$(gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=svc-cert-broker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  "https://cloudkms.googleapis.com/v1/projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/proxy-keyring/cryptoKeys/proxy-key:decrypt" \
  -d '{"ciphertext":"<base64>"}'
```

maria_infra: If that reproduces, then it's definitely an IAM change. I'm looking at the PRs — there was a cleanup that removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from a shared group and replaced with a narrower role, probably accidentally stripping this SA.

ops-bot: Incident note: created incident INC-2026-312, severity P2. Assigned to @raj_oncall and @maria_infra.

raj_oncall: Temporary mitigations while we restore RBAC: 1) Add a canary key with looser perms and point cert-broker to it (if feasible) 2) Use cached certs TTL bump (short-term) 3) Re-grant role and rotate keys. Prefer #3 if it can be done within 15m securely.

elena_sec: Reconfiguring to a canary key is risky for identity boundaries. I'd prefer re-grant+rotate. Also: we need to confirm audit logs capture both the IAM change and the KMS DENY events so compliance can review. How do we easily pull KMS logs for that key?

maria_infra: Query in cloud logging: 
```
resource.type="k8s_container" AND protoPayload.methodName="google.iam.admin.v1.SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.project_id="redwood-prod"
```
For KMS denies: 
```
protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com" AND protoPayload.status.code=7 AND resource.labels.key_ring_name="proxy-keyring"
```
That should show who removed the binding and the deny entries.

raj_oncall: Also run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --flatten="bindings[]" --filter="bindings.members:svc-cert-broker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --format="json(bindings.role,bindings.members)"` to see current bindings fast.

elena_sec: Good. Once RBAC restored, we should validate end-to-end: cert-broker should call KMS.decrypt successfully and proxies should fetch a fresh cert. Can we add an automated test in the cert-broker's CI that impersonates the SA and attempts a KMS decrypt (non-prod key) so future RBAC pruning fails CI?

maria_infra: Strong +1. We'll add a gating test to the infra-iam repo and a post-merge check in cert-broker CI that runs a small decrypt with a test key. Also will add an alert rule: if protoPayload.methodName=SetIamPolicy for critical key rings, ping #eng-security and create audit ticket.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for cert-broker (canary-017) — rollouts paused because preflight failed (decrypt test).

raj_oncall: Action items I have: 1) Re-add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to svc-cert-broker binding (temporary) and record change in ticket. 2) Run a key rotation and update cert-broker. 3) Add CI test and logging alert. 4) Correlate who merged the RBAC cleanup PR and chat with them.

elena_sec: I'll take logs for the compliance timeline and draft a short RCA blurb for legal/compliance: summary + timeline + mitigation + permanent fix.

maria_infra: I'll push the RBAC roll-forward now and paste the policy diff here shortly.

raj_oncall: If anyone sees more proxies degrade, DM me. After RBAC restore we'll do a coordinated rotate during low traffic window.

elena_sec: Thanks — appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
